message: 詠み人しらず
The Demons have been getting stronger.
Whether we're going to repel them or settle things peacefully, we Crusaders need equal strength too. I have to train so I can get stronger!
Looking for a place where I can train, I stroll around the academy grounds on Sunday.

name: Azel
message: 「...? What are you doing?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm reading a poetry collection.」
I ran into Azel and Misasagi-senpai in the courtyard.
Holding a large-format photobook in one hand, Azel tilts her head slightly and stares at Misasagi-senpai sitting on the edge of the fountain.

name: Azel
message: 「Are books not meant to be perused indoors?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel? It's totally fine to read out under the sun, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, good day to you, President.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you know the answer? That librarian never mentioned anything of the sort.」
Azel directs her question at me this time.

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh... There's no single right way to read a book, though...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Azel-han, are ya talkin' about Melilot-han?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, stay removed from the secular world and you're bound to lose touch with common sense. Unless you live alongside ordinary folks, you'll never know how they feel.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see, I understand.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, wanna try reading it together with me?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm in the middle of a survey.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Come now, don't say that. You've got a big photobook there, don't you? You borrowed it from the library, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai, did you come to the academy to read?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Truth is, I came here to see Rii-a.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, they're making a rather serious face in the Student Council room, so I can't go bothering them. Guess I'll just quietly make my exit.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I chat with the President and Rii-a all the time, so I haven't had the chance to talk with Azel yet, you see.」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」
A curt reply. That must mean Azel just happened to pass by here and called out to Senior Misasagi.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even if you say you don't need anything... you're always just drinking ice water at Prier, Azel-han. Drink nothing but water like that and you'll upset your stomach, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「Half of it is for hydration. The other half is because they're sold out and I have no choice.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean Vandine Jelly?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes. That place runs out of stock immediately. It is inefficient.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It sure is strange, isn't it? They hardly stock any items to sell, yet they're handing out free samples.」

name: Azel
message: 「What are 'free samples'?」

name: Synn
message: 「They're things like samples of new products given out to customers for free.」

name: Azel
message: 「For free!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's right. How about these, Azel?」
Misasagi-senpai pulls two pouches of Vandine Jelly out of her pocket.

name: Azel
message: 「Nngh!!」
T-The look in her eyes completely changed...

name: Misasagi
message: 「I got a whole bunch of them, you see. I've already had a taste myself, so why don't you try them too, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「You're giving them to me!?」
As she speaks, Azel snatches the jellies right out of Misasagi-senpai's hands.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, you have to say thank you.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I thank you.」
Was Azel hungry or something? She already tears one open and sucks down the jelly.

name: Azel
message: 「Mm... sweet.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's the new product, Vandine Polyphenol Jelly: Raisin Flavor.」

name: Synn
message: 「B-Both of them, all at once...」

name: Azel
message: 「Mm... astringent.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That one is Vandine Cartilage Jelly: Grape & Persimmon Flavor.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. I now understand the colors and flavors.」

name: Synn
message: 「...? Isn't it written right on the package?」

name: Azel
message: 「Jelly flavors can be identified by the color of the packaging. There is no particular need to learn the written characters.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry. You did just come here to study abroad, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「...It isn't that I cannot read it. It is merely difficult to comprehend.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Are you still not quite used to the writing around here, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「...The spoken language of this world is not particularly difficult, yet its characters and sentences are complex to the point of absurdity.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's impressive--you're communicating with us just fine, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Take me, for example--the other day on my way to school, a foreigner asked me for directions.」

name: Synn
message: 「I understood that they were asking, 'Where is the wharf?' And I knew the answer too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, my brain went into overdrive trying to piece a sentence together, and I couldn't even pull it off.」

name: Synn
message: 「In the end, the only thing that blurted out of my mouth was a single 'This way!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, they just needed to go straight down the road, so I kept pointing frantically over and over--'This way!' 'This way!' 'This way!'」

name: Synn
message: 「To anyone watching, I must've looked completely ridiculous.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Hmph.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You managed to answer them properly, so isn't that wonderful? Me, I did something even sillier, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I wanted to have a pen pal from overseas, so I sent off a long, polite letter in English--and then I got an overwhelmingly fluent reply back.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I couldn't understand a single bit of what they'd written, so I never wrote back and just left it at that.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. I can understand that.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Did you borrow a photo book so you could understand things visually, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Not quite.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Would you mind letting me take a quick look?」

name: Azel
message: 「Go ahead.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're skimming through that at an incredible speed.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here you go, back to you. It's a lovely photo book.」

name: Azel
message: 「How can you tell? You only looked at it for a mere few seconds.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's true I only glanced through it, but that book only has minimal captions, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「Does that make it a bad photo book, then?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Isn't it the opposite? They probably kept it sparse on purpose.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If each viewer has their own memories, those annotations can expand endlessly in their hearts, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see, I understand.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Azel-han? It doesn't matter if it takes time, so isn't it better to read at your own pace?」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not understand the proper procedure for reading.」

name: Azel
message: 「First of all, the fifty sounds of a-i-u-e-o, ka-ki-ku-ke-ko are inefficient.」

name: Azel
message: 「I acknowledge the regularity and rules of vowels and consonants, yet it is a mere string of characters devoid of meaning.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Though the blossoms are fragrant, they must scatter; who in this world remains unchanged? Crossing the deep mountains of vanity today, I dream no shallow dreams, nor grow tipsy.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's wordplay. In classical Japanese--」

name: Azel
message: 「Wait. I am comprehending it now... Iroha...」

name: Azel
message: 「Those are the fifty sounds. Moreover, it is a poem with meaning.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Aren't you quite the clever child, Azel-han?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There are others too, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「Let me hear them.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now then, have a seat.」

name: Azel
message: 「I will sit.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, President-han?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes. I'll head to the Student Council room. I have to solve Ria-senpai's problem! Besides--」
I exchange a silent greeting with my eyes and quietly step away from the fountain so as not to disturb the two of them.
Besides... she's smooth! Misasagi-senpai wanted to talk with Azel, and she pulled it off brilliantly.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heaven, earth, stars, sky; mountains, rivers, peaks, valleys; clouds, mist, chambers, moss; people, dogs, tops, ends; let sulfur and monkeys grow, tamed upon the hackberry branches.」

name: Azel
message: 「...It differs from the previous one, yet it holds meaning.」

name: Azel
message: 「Once again, it is the fifty sounds. Moreover, these are words that depict the world.」
If I could, I'd love to stay by Azel's side and listen in, but I head toward the old school building.
